title: ledger.transfers.v1
description: One message on the Redpanda topic ledger.transfers.v1, produced by services/amqp-redpanda-bridge for exactly one TigerBeetle CDC change event, keyed by transferId. Every field is derived, unchanged, from the `tigerbeetle amqp` 0.17.4 change-event payload (src/cdc/runner.zig, `pub const Message`). See contracts/events/README.md for the field-by-field provenance and the versioning rule. The consumer-side decoder is dev.fondaria.ledger.event.LedgerEventDecoder in libs/ledger-client.

schemaVersion.description: The event schema version. A consumer that does not recognise this value must route the message to its dead-letter topic, never attempt a best-effort parse. A backwards-incompatible change is a new version (v2) on a new topic, not an edit here.

eventType.description: The TigerBeetle change-event type (`@tagName` of src/tigerbeetle.zig ChangeEventType), lower snake_case.

ledger.description: The TigerBeetle ledger id (u32). 484 is the single MXN cash ledger; a value >= 1001 is a per-fund unit ledger. The decoder routes on this: 484 -> Money, >= 1001 -> Units; any other value is a hard decode error.

timestamp.description: The change event's ledger commit timestamp, u64 nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

transferId.description: The transfer id (u128). The Redpanda partition key for this topic.

amount.description: The transfer amount (u128), an unsigned base-10 integer. On the cash ledger it is MXN cents; on a unit ledger it is units scaled by 1e8. A fractional value in any form is rejected by the decoder, never coerced.

pendingId.description: The originating pending transfer id on a two-phase post/void; "0" otherwise.

transferCode.description: The transfer's user-defined code (u16); maps to LedgerCodes.TransferCode.

transferTimestamp.description: The transfer's own commit timestamp, u64 nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

debitAccountCode.description: The debited account's code (u16); maps to LedgerCodes.AccountCode.

creditAccountCode.description: The credited account's code (u16); maps to LedgerCodes.AccountCode.

uint128.description: An unsigned integer of up to 128 bits, carried as a canonical base-10 string (no leading zeros, no sign, no decimal point) because the connector emits values that a JSON number cannot hold exactly as strings and the bridge normalises every such field to this form.
